query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber:'38.423'}), (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release) WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected<>'' WITH DISTINCT cr,rel UNWIND split(cr.clausesAffected,',') AS rawClause WITH cr,rel,trim(rawClause) AS clause MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber:'38.423'}) WHERE sp.specRelease=rel.releaseName AND s.sectionNumber=clause RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS crTdoc,clause,s.sectionId AS sectionId
